metadata.dcterms:title: On the asymptotic expansions of the Kashaev invariant of the knots with 6 crossings
metadata.dcterms:creator: Ohtsuki, Tomotada
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We give presentations of the asymptotic expansions of the Kashaev invariant of the knots with 6 crossings. In particular, we show the volume conjecture for these knots, which states that the leading terms of the expansions present the hyperbolic volume and the Chern-Simons invariant of the complements of the knots. As higher coeﬃcients of the expansions, we obtain a new series of invariants of these knots. A non-trivial part of the proof is to apply the saddle point method to calculate the asymptotic expansion of an integral which presents the Kashaev invariant. A key step of this part is to give a concrete homotopy of the (real 3-dimensional) domain of the integral in C3 in such a way that the boundary of the domain always stays in a certain domain in C3 given by the potential function of the hyperbolic structure. Mathematics Subject Classiﬁcation (2010). Primary: 57M27. Secondary: 57M25, 57M50.
